name: tiqian-assembly-record
description: Single definition of the paragraph assembly record: the scalar fields and record tables a lowered DOM paragraph carries into the engine, the wire surfaces they travel on, and the source-semantics projection rules that produce them. TS and Rust type declarations are generated from this file (ADR 0053 A1); hand-written type files on those two sides are not allowed.

indexSpace.domain: the projected paragraph text produced by the CssWhiteSpaceCollapseProjection rule
indexSpace.ranges: half-open [start, end); 0 <= start < end <= length of the projected text

scalars.name: firstLineIndentIc
scalars.unit: ic (the em square of the paragraph face)

scalars.name: lineLengthGridEnabled
scalars.note: The runtime worker channel omits the flag: line-length grid arithmetic is unconditional there (ADR 0054 SingleGridArithmetic). The engine keeps accepting the flag so build-time requests can differ.

scalars.name: locale
scalars.note: Enters LayoutInput and selects font and punctuation profiles. The lowering default matches the core TextStyle default.

scalars.name: fontFamilies
scalars.note: Paragraph base families; per-span families override.

scalars.name: text
scalars.note: The projected text; the raw five-table name for it is the text table.

scalars.name: fontSessionId
scalars.note: Build-time only: binds the request to a font session registered on the engine side. The runtime worker channel addresses sessions through its own initialization messages.

tables.name: textSpans

fields.name: fontFamilies
fields.note: empty list means inherit the paragraph families

tables.note: Per-span locale is not on the wire; spans use the paragraph locale.

tables.name: sourceBoundaries
tables.note: Element boundaries of the source DOM, expressed in projected-text offsets. The engine uses them for source-range mapping and repair decisions.

tables.name: lineBreakSpans
tables.note: Overrides the paragraph break policy inside the range.

tables.name: inlineBoxes
tables.note: Measured inline edges (padding, border) of a styled inline element.

tables.name: inlineObjects
tables.note: Opaque replaced elements measured on the main thread. Runtime surface only: the build-time corpus contains no measured DOM elements, so the Rust packer has no field for this table. Boundary adjustment is engine-side Fixed and is not on the wire.

workerJson.transport: structured-clone JSON message to the layout worker
workerJson.naming: camelCase keys, exactly the LAYOUT_REQUEST_FIELDS list

rustAbi.transport: packed little-endian binary buffer, magic TQLR, revision 1; byte layout documented in ffi/native/tiqian_layout_abi.h
rustAbi.typeGeneration: generated struct and enum declarations in ffi/rust/tiqian

engineWireFace.note: The engine-side parser is the reference decoder; TS and Rust types are generated toward it, not from it.

projection.input: text nodes with computed white-space modes plus the hard-break offsets
projection.output: projected text and the boundary map from source offsets to projected offsets
projection.rule: collapsible whitespace runs collapse to a single space; leading and trailing runs at element boundaries trim; preserved-break modes keep breaks; a recorded hard break never collapses

projection.output: a newline in the raw text at the recorded offset; the offset enters CssWhiteSpaceCollapseProjection as a hard break
projection.rule: only a marked br contributes a structural break; unmarked br elements contribute nothing

projection.input: computed style change points across the source DOM
projection.rule: consecutive characters with equal projected style join one run; element edges register a boundary

projection.input: strong, b and emphasized source elements
projection.output: fontWeight in textSpans; decorations with kind Emphasis when strongAsEmphasisMarks is set
projection.rule: weight wins for font selection; the decoration layer carries the emphasis semantics

projection.input: inline elements with measured inline padding or border
projection.output: inlineBoxes records with inlineStart and inlineEnd edges in px

projection.input: opaque replaced elements measured on the main thread
projection.output: a U+FFFC placeholder in the projected text plus an inlineObjects record with advance, ascent and descent
